TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_NOTICE_PROFILING.name: Notice Profiling

activation.trigger: whenever a creature within range uses Analyze or another feature that explicitly learns one of your Analyzable Characteristics

description: While you hold Martial Focus, you know whenever a creature within 120 feet uses Analyze or another feature that explicitly learns one of your Analyzable Characteristics.
When this occurs, you may expend Martial Focus to learn:
which of your characteristics the creature learned during the current round; and
which creatures within range learned those characteristics.
Notice Profiling does not detect ordinary observation, guessing, or knowledge a creature possessed before entering range.
The table records explicit combat facts. Ask the GM to confirm narrative characteristics through the recorded-learning path; merely becoming Analyzed does not confirm learning.
notes: Notice Profiling does not detect ordinary observation, guessing, or knowledge a creature possessed before entering range.
